name: store differences from the predecessor
mechanism: replace each value by its difference from the previous value (or from a prediction), so slowly varying data becomes small numbers that a later stage codes cheaply

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Delta encoding' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossless compression algorithms: aid to compression of data in which sequential data occurs frequently
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Incremental encoding': delta encoding applied to sequences of strings

fails_when: one corrupted value corrupts everything after it
